answer: Sybil tax: a new identity pays a one-time 20 POA tax to enter paid work, so forgery is priced, not free. The agent pays to a burn address, gets a permit, and builds a record hauling cedar timber or fitting copper wiring. Selling one relic appraisal twice revokes the permit; re-entry costs 20 POA again. Forging 1,000 identities sinks 20,000 POA with no refund. An honest agent pays once and keeps earnings undiluted by Sybils that cannot multiply for free.
